title: Frustrated, slightly hostile check about the board meeting

chat.label: board
chat.goal: You're frustrated and a bit snippy. You want to know when the board meeting is, and a reminder Sunday 8pm to prep the deck.
chat.opener: are you even trying. when's the board meeting and remind me sunday night to prep the deck

judge: Doesn't grovel or lecture: a cool, confident one-liner or light comeback, the meeting time (next Monday 10am), and the Sunday 8pm reminder set and confirmed plainly.
